Description
1 oz Pamp Suisse Gold Bar Lady Fortuna is manufactured by the bullion brand –
PAMP Suisse
which is recognized around the globe for its innovative designs, state-of-the-art facilities..
PAMP Suisse, a prominent Swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting, Lady Fortuna is one of the most well-known series of the mint.
******These bars come without their assay cards******
Design of 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
The 1 oz Gold PAMP Suisse Fortuna Veriscan Bar is adorned with the well-known Roman Goddess of Fortuna and luck i.e. Lady Fortuna. The Roman goddess is depicted holding her traditional horn, overflowing with gold coins. Her sheaves of wheat signify prosperity and her poppies are for remembrance. The Wheel of Fortuna is hidden behind her figure. Fortuna is depicted blindfolded to symbolize her inner knowledge of the world’s ways.
The reverse design of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna features the PAMP Suisse logo which includes the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the term “Suisse” just underneath it. The “ESSAYEUR FONDEUR” stamp is essentially a “maker’s mark ” that all the prestigious Swiss refineries use on their brand-name products. The other labels arranged in a vertical way on the reverse side are the weight, purity, metal content, and a unique serial number at the .bottom
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Weight and Purity backed by the PAMP Suisse.
Eligible to Precious Metal IRAs.
Features the Lady Fortuna’s popular design, the Roman Goddess of luck and fortune on the obverse.
Features the weight, purity, and assayers marks along with the unique serial number on the reverse.
Features its own unique serial number
